questions.question: Which of the following is NOT a part of India's first indigenous anti-nuclear medical kit?
questions.solution:
**Saline Solution** is not a part of India's first indigenous anti-nuclear medical kit.

Institute of Nuclear Medicine and Allied Sciences (INMAS) has developed India’s first indigenous anti-nuclear medical kit.

The kit may ensure protection from serious injuries and faster healing of wounds resulting from nuclear warfare or radioactive leakage.

**Content of the kit:-**

 
• **Prussian blue tablets** - provides 100 per cent absorption from the gut and other portals of entry to the human body and are highly effective in incorporating Radio Cesium (Cs-137) and Radio Thallium.
 
• Ethylenediaminetetraacetic acid (EDTA) injection - traps uranium in the guts and blood of victims during a nuclear accident or warfare.
 
• Ca-EDTA Respiratory Fluid - inhalation formula for chelation, or grabbing, of heavy metals and radioactive elements deposited in lungs through inhalation at nuclear accident sites. When injected into the veins, it “grabs” heavy metals and minerals and removes them from the body.
 
• Anti-gamma ray skin ointment - protects and heals the radiation damage on the skin.
 
• Amifostine injection - conventional radiopharmaceutical that limits damage from gamma radiation.
 
• Radioactive urine/biofluid collector - can safely dispose of the urine of a person affected by radiation.

• It is an **allotrope** of carbon having **hexagonal structure.**
 
• It is the **most stable form of carbon** under standard conditions.
 
• It is a **good conductor of heat and electricity.**
 
• Its high conductivity makes it useful in electronic products such as **electrodes, batteries, and solar panels.**
 
• **Extra:-__**
 
• **__Allotropes__**

 
• They are the different physical form occurrence of the same chemical element.
 
• For example **graphite and diamond** both are allotropes of carbon but vary vastly in their properties.
 
• **Diamond is the hardest known natural mineral.**
 
• Some newly discovered carbon allotropes are** buckminsterfullerene and graphene**.

questions.question: Mucosa, Submucosa, Muscularis and Adventitia are the four layers of the _______ wall.
questions.solution:
• **Mucosa, Submucosa, Muscularis and** **Adventitia **are the four layers of the **gastrointestinal wall.**
 
• The **mucosa** is the **innermost layer** of the gastrointestinal tract. It surrounds the lumen of the tract, and comes into direct contact with digested food.
 
• The **submucosa** is a **thin layer of ****tissue** in the gastrointestinal tract. It is the layer of dense irregular connective tissue that supports the mucosa and joins it to the muscular layer, the bulk of overlying smooth muscle.
 
• The **adventitia** is the **outer layer** of fibrous connective tissue surrounding the tract.
 
• In the gastrointestinal tract, the muscular layer is bounded in most cases by **serosa.** However, at the oral cavity, thoracic esophagus, ascending colon, descending colon and the rectum, the muscular layer is instead bounded by **adventitia.**

questions.question: ________ states that 'bad money drives good money out circulation'.
questions.solution:
__
 
• **Gresham’s law** states that **“bad money drives out the good money”.**
 
• Good money here means any currency or coin whose accepted value (legal tender value) and the value of the commodity from which it is made does not differ much.
 
• Bad money means the coin or currency whose accepted value (legal tender value) is much higher than the value of the commodity from which it is made.
 
• For example-
 
 
• If a coin has a legal tender value of Rs 100 and the silver metal worth Rs 100 is used to make the coin, then it will be considered as good money in Gresham’s law.
 
• If a coin has a legal tender value of Rs 100 and the alloy worth Rs 5 is used to make the coin, then it will be considered as bad money in Gresham’s law.
 
 
 
• Thus, he said that if both kinds of money is available with public, having same legal tender value, then **people would start hoarding good money and would use bad money for transaction.**
 
• So, as per our example, people will start hoarding silver coins for their intrinsic value and start using alloy coins for transactions.
 
• Thus, eventually bad money will drive out the good money.
 
• **Engel’s Law:-**__ As income rises, the proportion of income spent on food decreases.
 
• __**Baxter’s law:-**__** **states that monopoly in a regulated industry can affect and even dominate an another non-regulated industry, if the former serves as an input to the latter.
 
• __**Campbell’s Law:- **__ States that more and more quantitative indicators are used to monitor a social situation, more they will be prone to corruption and distortions.

• They also believe that anybody can attain liberation(including women).
 
• Digamabara Jains are those to whom** “space is the garment” **and **do not wear anything**.
 
• The *Digambara* Jains **worship completely nude idols** of ***tirthankaras* **(omniscient beings) and *siddha* (liberated souls). The *tirthankara* is represented either seated in yoga posture or standing in the ***Kayotsarga* **posture.
 
• They believe that** liberation can only be attained through male body** and **nudity is necessary** to break the bondage of illusory world.
 
• **Extra:-**__

• ***ahiṃsā*** (non-violence),** *satya* **(truth), ***asteya*** (not stealing), ***brahmacharya*** (celibacy or chastity or sexual continence), and ***aparigraha***** **(non-attachment)

questions.question: Researchers of Kerala-based Amrita University in collaboration with the Sikkim State Disaster Management Authority have developed a real-time _______. This system can help save lives and prevent loss to property by issuing advance alerts.
questions.solution:
__
 
• Researchers of **Kerala-based Amrita University** in collaboration with the **Sikkim State Disaster Management Authority **have developed a real-time **Landslide warning system****.**
 
• The system gives advance warnings of landslides so that people can be safely evacuated before disaster strikes.
 
• After successfully deploying India’s first such system in Kerala’s Western Ghats, it will now be deployed in Sikkim to guard against rainfall-induced landslides in the Sikkim-Darjeeling belt. 
 
• The system collects real-time, continuous data from the sensors, performs basic analysis at the Field Management Center (FMC) located on the site in Sikkim and relays it to the Data Management Center (DMC) at Amrita Vishwa Vidyapeetham in Kerala’s Kollam district.
 
• The project is jointly funded by the **Ministry of Earth Sciences**, Government of India, and **Amrita Vishwa Vidyapeetham**.
 
• **Extra:-__**
 
• In 2008, Amrita set up **India's first landslide laboratory** which can create small landslides under controlled conditions and act as the feedback system for field deployment.
 
• **Amrita Vishwa Vidyapeetham **has been ranked 8th among the Indian universities by NIRF in 2019.

• But TESS can cover an area 400 times the area that could be covered by kepler mission.

questions.question: In September 2018, _________ signed a memorandum of understanding with India to share its expertise on Gaganyaan ISRO's first manned space mission.

• **India and France** on September 6, 2018 signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) to constitute a working group for **Gaganyaan Mission, India’s first manned space mission.**
 
• **ISRO and CNES**, the French space agency, will be combining their expertise in fields of space medicine, astronaut health monitoring, life support, radiation protection, space debris protection and personal hygiene systems.
 
• **Gaganyaan Mission:__**
 
 
• It is Indian Human Space flight Mission in a spacecraft named “Gaganyaan”.
 
• The first crewed spacecraft mission is scheduled to be launched in **December 2021 **with** 3 crew members onboard.**.
 
• On successful completion **India** will become the **fourth nation** to have launched independent human spaceflight mission after **USSR/Russia, United States and China.**
